[[File:Pumpkin patch.gif|left|thumb|Pumpkins growing in the garden.]]
Pumpkins are a form of crop which can be grown from [[pumpkin seed]]s in the garden below the [[workyard]] known as the [[Kitchen Garden|kitchen garden]]. Alternatively they can be purchased from the [[Farmer]]. Pumpkins are an improvable crop, meaning they have a variety of quality levels and can be improved with fertilizer.  See the page on [[farming]] for more information on how crops are grown and improved.

==Alchemy==
Pumpkins are decomposable into powder at the [[Alchemy mill]] and extract at each of the distillation cubes. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] will produce one extra reagent at each workstation.

==QUESTS==
During a mission from Game of Crone, you will require a gold quality pumpkin to enchant (plus 50 silver), that you'll need to bring to Clotho.
